ol.li: Power down the chassis and wait for the fans to stop.
Attach an anti-static wrist strap to the chassis frame.
Remove the blanking plate from the target bay.
Slide the module in until the connector engages.
Tighten the captive screw on the module faceplate.
Confirm that the module appears in the inventory list.

section.title: Additional modules
section.p: Repeat steps 4 through 6 for each additional module.
